changelog: Matches the selected music section: albums, album artists, artists, playlists, songs, genres and collections. Uses Jellyfin 12 Persons for artists, supports filtered album browsing, preserves playlist order and separates selection/sort contexts. Suggestions remain native. Bounds stalled catalog loads.
description: Adds an accessible CoverFlow browser to Jellyfin Web for existing media libraries. It uses Jellyfin metadata and images without modifying library data.
name: CoverFlow
overview: Browse Jellyfin libraries with a 3D CoverFlow interface.
